text: You come, no doubt, from Katerina Ivanovna. Allow me--not there. Sit here....” At Sonia’s entrance, Razumihin, who had been sitting on one of Raskolnikov’s three chairs, close to the door, got up to allow her to enter. Raskolnikov had at first shown her the place on the sofa where Zossimov had been sitting, but feeling that the sofa which served him as a bed, was too familiar a place, he hurriedly motioned her to Razumihin’s chair. “You sit here,” he said to Razumihin, putting him on the sofa.
